info.title: PIM_Router
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

active_active.description: Enables PIM active-active feature on the PIM router which is part of VSX pair. If the value is true, then the VSX peer which is not forwarding the multicast traffic, acts as proxy-DR and learns multicast routes. The multicast routes in proxy-DR would be written as bridge entries in the hardware. If the value is false, then PIM active-active feature would be turned off. In this case, if the VSX peer which is forwarding the multicast stream goes down, other peer would send joins only after the neighbor expiry. So it takes time to resume multicast traffic.

anycast_rp_source_directly_connected.description: To allow same multicast source to be directly connected to two or more Anycast RP routers. This is optional when the source is directly connected to a single Anycast RP or when the source is at least one hop away from the RP.

bfd_all_interfaces_enable.description: Enables BFD on all PIM interfaces.

bidir_software_routing.description: Indicates if multicast data packets need to be routed in software by BIDIr  until flows are programmed in hardware.

bsm_last_received_time.description: The epoch time at which the last BSM is received on this router.

bsr_elected_time.description: The epoch time at which the E-BSR is elected as known by this router.

bst_last_expired_time.description: The epoch time at which the Bootstrap Timer last expired on this router.

candidate_bsr_bsm_interval.description: Periodic interval(in seconds) at which the BSMs are originated from this router.

candidate_bsr_hash_mask_length.description: Candidate-BSR's hash mask length on this router. If this is not set, then default value 30 is used for IPv4 PIM-SM and default value 126 for IPv6 PIM-SM.

candidate_bsr_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Candidate Bootstrap Router (Candidate-BSR) port on this router. Candidate-BSR [Port](#/Port) must be specified to enable BSR operations. IP address of this port will be advertised as the Candidate-BSR address. If this is not set, then Candidate-BSR will not be operational.

candidate_rp_adv_interval.description: Periodic interval(in seconds) at which the Candidate-RP advertisements are originated from this router.

candidate_rp_group_prefix.description: Multicast group prefix associated with this Candidate-RP. The entries are valid only when [candidate_rp_port](#/PIM_Router) is configured. An empty value with a valid Candidate-RP port in [candidate_rp_port](#/PIM_Router) means that this Candidate-RP is handling all the possible multicast groups. This entries will take the format IP-ADDR/MASK-LEN.

candidate_rp_holdtime.description: Candidate-RP's Holdtime (in seconds) on this router.

candidate_rp_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Candidate Rendezvous Point (Candidate-RP) port on this router. Candidate-RP [Port](#/Port) must be specified to enable Candidate-RP operations. If this is not set, then Candidate-RP will not be operational.

clear_mroute_request.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Clear_Mroute_Request](#/PIM_Clear_Mroute_Request)
List of clear requests associated with Multicast route entries.

delayed_dr_interval.description: Delay (in seconds) before the router advertises the DR priority.

elected_bsr_address.description: IP Address of the elected BSR on this router.

elected_bsr_hash_mask_length.description: Hash mask length of the elected BSR on this router.

elected_bsr_priority.description: Priority of the elected BSR on this router.

ip_version.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router)
PIM router entries keyed by IP version. This can have one [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router) entry per IP version. If this is not set, then PIM will be disabled on this VRF.

ivrl_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
List of VRFs on which the Multicast Source is present. Multicast traffic from these list of VRFs will be leaked to the VRF on which the receivers are present.

join_prune_interval.description: Frequency (in seconds) at which this router sends PIM Join/Prune messages.

mroutes_limit.description: Limit on the maximum number of multicast route entries that can be programmed. If this is not set, then the limit specified in the system capacities will be honored. When the limit is configured, multicast route entries created because of IGMP or MLD membership reports and multicast route entries created because of multicast streams are restricted under the configured limit.

pim_static_rps.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Static_RP](#/PIM_Static_RP)
Static RPs for the specified multicast prefixes expressed as (IP-ADDR/MASK-LEN) and [PIM_Static_RP](#/PIM_Static_RP) entry. There can exist only one RP address for a unique group prefix.

redistribute_static_mroute.description: If redistributing static multicast route to PIM is enabled, the static multicast routes configured are sent as PIM joins to the upstream connected PIM router.

register_acl.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Ingress ACL to filter processing of PIM register messages received from peer devices. When this is not configured, all PIM register messages will be processed.

register_messages_limit.description: Limit on the maximum number of register messages sent per second for every unique (S,G) entry. If this is not set, then there is no maximum rate set. When the limit is configured, register messages generated exceeding the configured limit will be suppressed.

router_enable.description: Enables PIM protocol on this router.

rp_group_acls.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Ingress ACL to filter PIM join and prune messages received from peer devices based on the RP address and its associated (S, G) information specified in those messages. When this is not configured, all PIM join and prune messages will be processed.

rpf_override.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_Multicast_Nexthop](#/Static_Multicast_Nexthop)
Overrides normal RPF lookup mechanism for multicast routes matching ip_prefix IP-ADDR/MASK-LEN with the gateway ip/port

sources_per_group.description: Total number of sources allowed for a group on this router. If this is not set, then there is no limit on the number of sources for a group. When the number of sources for a group exceeds the configured limit multicast traffic from additional sources will be dropped.

spt_threshold_disable.description: Enables Shortest Path Tree(SPT) switching on this router.

ssm_enable.description: Enables PIM SSM protocol on this router.

ssm_range_acl.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
ACL to indicate the SSM range. If this is not configured, default SSM range will be used.

state_refresh.description: Periodic interval (in seconds) at which state refresh datagrams are  transmitted by this router. This is applicable when PIM mode is set to 'dense'.

static_rp_acls.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
ACL to filter the group addresses for this RP Address. On the source DR, only group addresses which are permitted will be registered to RP. When applied on other routers, PIM (*,G) join and prune messages will be filtered.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

In this case, if the VSX peer which is forwarding the multicast stream goes down, other peer would send joins only after the neighbor expiry. So it takes time to resume multicast traffic.

anycast_rp_source_directly_connected.description: To allow same multicast source to be directly connected to two or more Anycast RP routers. This is optional when the source is directly connected to a single Anycast RP or when the source is at least one hop away from the RP.

bfd_all_interfaces_enable.description: Enables BFD on all PIM interfaces.

bidir_software_routing.description: Indicates if multicast data packets need to be routed in software by BIDIr  until flows are programmed in hardware.

candidate_bsr_bsm_interval.description: Periodic interval(in seconds) at which the BSMs are originated from this router.

candidate_bsr_hash_mask_length.description: Candidate-BSR's hash mask length on this router. If this is not set, then default value 30 is used for IPv4 PIM-SM and default value 126 for IPv6 PIM-SM.

candidate_bsr_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Candidate Bootstrap Router (Candidate-BSR) port on this router. Candidate-BSR [Port](#/Port) must be specified to enable BSR operations. IP address of this port will be advertised as the Candidate-BSR address. If this is not set, then Candidate-BSR will not be operational.

candidate_rp_adv_interval.description: Periodic interval(in seconds) at which the Candidate-RP advertisements are originated from this router.

candidate_rp_group_prefix.description: Multicast group prefix associated with this Candidate-RP. The entries are valid only when [candidate_rp_port](#/PIM_Router) is configured. An empty value with a valid Candidate-RP port in [candidate_rp_port](#/PIM_Router) means that this Candidate-RP is handling all the possible multicast groups. This entries will take the format IP-ADDR/MASK-LEN.

candidate_rp_holdtime.description: Candidate-RP's Holdtime (in seconds) on this router.

candidate_rp_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Candidate Rendezvous Point (Candidate-RP) port on this router. Candidate-RP [Port](#/Port) must be specified to enable Candidate-RP operations. If this is not set, then Candidate-RP will not be operational.

clear_mroute_request.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Clear_Mroute_Request](#/PIM_Clear_Mroute_Request)
List of clear requests associated with Multicast route entries.

delayed_dr_interval.description: Delay (in seconds) before the router advertises the DR priority.

ip_version.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router)
PIM router entries keyed by IP version. This can have one [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router) entry per IP version. If this is not set, then PIM will be disabled on this VRF.

ivrl_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
List of VRFs on which the Multicast Source is present. Multicast traffic from these list of VRFs will be leaked to the VRF on which the receivers are present.

join_prune_interval.description: Frequency (in seconds) at which this router sends PIM Join/Prune messages.

mroutes_limit.description: Limit on the maximum number of multicast route entries that can be programmed. If this is not set, then the limit specified in the system capacities will be honored. When the limit is configured, multicast route entries created because of IGMP or MLD membership reports and multicast route entries created because of multicast streams are restricted under the configured limit.

pim_static_rps.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Static_RP](#/PIM_Static_RP)
Static RPs for the specified multicast prefixes expressed as (IP-ADDR/MASK-LEN) and [PIM_Static_RP](#/PIM_Static_RP) entry. There can exist only one RP address for a unique group prefix.

redistribute_static_mroute.description: If redistributing static multicast route to PIM is enabled, the static multicast routes configured are sent as PIM joins to the upstream connected PIM router.

register_acl.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Ingress ACL to filter processing of PIM register messages received from peer devices. When this is not configured, all PIM register messages will be processed.

register_messages_limit.description: Limit on the maximum number of register messages sent per second for every unique (S,G) entry. If this is not set, then there is no maximum rate set. When the limit is configured, register messages generated exceeding the configured limit will be suppressed.

router_enable.description: Enables PIM protocol on this router.

rp_group_acls.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Ingress ACL to filter PIM join and prune messages received from peer devices based on the RP address and its associated (S, G) information specified in those messages. When this is not configured, all PIM join and prune messages will be processed.

rpf_override.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_Multicast_Nexthop](#/Static_Multicast_Nexthop)
Overrides normal RPF lookup mechanism for multicast routes matching ip_prefix IP-ADDR/MASK-LEN with the gateway ip/port

sources_per_group.description: Total number of sources allowed for a group on this router. If this is not set, then there is no limit on the number of sources for a group. When the number of sources for a group exceeds the configured limit multicast traffic from additional sources will be dropped.

spt_threshold_disable.description: Enables Shortest Path Tree(SPT) switching on this router.

ssm_enable.description: Enables PIM SSM protocol on this router.

ssm_range_acl.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
ACL to indicate the SSM range. If this is not configured, default SSM range will be used.

state_refresh.description: Periodic interval (in seconds) at which state refresh datagrams are  transmitted by this router. This is applicable when PIM mode is set to 'dense'.

static_rp_acls.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
ACL to filter the group addresses for this RP Address. On the source DR, only group addresses which are permitted will be registered to RP. When applied on other routers, PIM (*,G) join and prune messages will be filtered.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: PIM_Router.ip_version
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router)
PIM router entries keyed by IP version. This can have one [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router) entry per IP version. If this is not set, then PIM will be disabled on this VRF.
